verification_policy: Each record is independently sourced from the structured research corpus and remains partially_verified until reconciled against canonical acquisition and in-game tables.

records.name: Evil Flight Strike
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 21 "Tri-Race Coop"; 40% on any clear.
records.skill_description: Rising stretch-arm barrage that leaves the target airborne for an immediate follow-up.
records.mechanics_notes: Eight-hit ascent. The research source identifies a large whiff-recovery vulnerability and a separate evasive version tied to the Power Awakening kit.
records.pve_notes: Useful race-restricted launcher for combo routing and airborne follow-ups.
records.pvp_notes: Strong confirm reward but risky on whiff; the stamina cost makes careless neutral use expensive.

records.name: Lightning Impact
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 142 "Timespace Tussle"; 28% conditional-finish slot; also TP Medal rotations.
records.skill_description: Chargeable Ki wave whose power increases with rapid inputs; touching the caster during the charge paralyzes the attacker.
records.mechanics_notes: The charge state functions as a contact-stun field, discouraging melee interruption. Ranged attacks remain a counterplay option.
records.pve_notes: Especially useful against aggressive melee enemies that attempt to interrupt charge skills.
records.pvp_notes: Punishes direct melee interruption but remains vulnerable to ranged pressure and extended charge time.

records.name: Excellent Full Course
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 142 "Timespace Tussle"; also TP Medal Shop rotations.
records.skill_description: Rapid multi-charge rush in which every charge must connect to unlock the final Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: All-or-nothing sequence: missing a charge ends the sequence before the finisher.
records.pve_notes: Performs well against stationary or stamina-broken targets.
records.pvp_notes: Requires setup and a reliable confirm because a missed charge forfeits the finisher.

records.name: Photon Swipe
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 139 "War and Pieces"; 37% Ultimate Finish bonus slot; also TP Medal rotations.
records.skill_description: Wide horizontal fingertip beam that trades damage for lane coverage and projectile-clearing utility.
records.mechanics_notes: Single sweeping pass with knockback; research source documents the ability to cut through large incoming attacks in raid and Expert Mission situations.
records.pve_notes: Particularly valuable for crowd control and projectile-heavy raid/Expert Mission encounters.
records.pvp_notes: Low raw damage but strong horizontal coverage for catching lateral movement.

records.name: Ultimate Charge
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 134 "Universe 7's Next God of Destruction"; 25% conditional-finish bonus slot; also TP Medal rotations.
records.skill_description: Ki charge whose recovery starts slowly and accelerates the longer the charge is maintained.
records.mechanics_notes: Designed for large sustained refills. Its opening recovery is deliberately slower than quick-charge alternatives.
records.pve_notes: Excellent for builds that consume large amounts of Ki between safe recharge windows.
records.pvp_notes: Best used in safe recovery windows; poor for tiny opportunistic Ki top-ups because of the slow opening ramp.

records.name: Burst Charge
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 134 "Universe 7's Next God of Destruction"; 25% first-clear bonus slot; also TP Medal rotations.
records.skill_description: Fast-starting Ki charge whose recovery rate decreases the longer it is held.
records.mechanics_notes: Opposite charge curve to Ultimate Charge: strongest at the beginning and intended for short taps rather than prolonged charging.
records.pve_notes: Good for quickly restoring a few bars between attacks without committing to a long charge.
records.pvp_notes: Rewards short charge windows and discourages holding the button too long, reducing exposure to interruption.
